metadata.supervision_protocol: all matching-class source_train and all target_train labels visible
metadata.protocol_deviation: Fair-comparison adaptation uses all source/target labels and RGB/NIR/AIS inputs instead of the paper's source-free few-shot budget; the TIR, CoOp and LoRA mechanisms and the previously validated full-support optimizer scale are retained
metadata.training_update_semantics: one accumulated full-epoch update over source+target training data
metadata.checkpoint_policy: in-memory best state; no model files retained
metadata.ais_input: heading sin/cos, length, and width only; validity mask is gating-only
metadata.image_input: 8-bit-semantics RGB scaling (/255 with sparse outlier clipping), CLIP normalization at 224x224, plus learned NIR residual

normalization.rule: statistics fitted only on: source_train + target_train

metadata.augmentation: paired light random crop and horizontal/vertical flips
